crossRefs.note: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning Yahweh’s name, she came to test him with hard questions.
Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

people.name: Abimael
people.line: Descendant of Shem, son of Joktan

people.name: Sheba
people.line: Descendant of Joktan, settling in southern Arabia
